guide: code-review.md, Svelte 5 patterns: using $effect for data transformations instead of $derived. Violation: the effect body only reads reactive values and assigns values computed from them to local state, with no other effect. Clean: the effect touches the DOM, calls an API or store, dispatches events, runs async work, or initializes once behind a guard. Syncing an editable draft from a prop is left out (ambiguous). Filling an editable field from a prop when it is empty is also left out.
